integrity: Full derivation and independently reconstructed exact-rational finite checks are supplied; symbolic identities determine the complete infinite parameter family. Finite sample checks are auxiliary. No independent scientific review or external validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The computation concerns canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut and cycle projections on real unit-edge clique–star Cartesian-product graphs, not minimum norms over all projections, weighted graphs, or other coordinate norms. Existing published results motivate the question but do not independently validate the new formula. The initial electrical transfer-current representation is standard; the absolute-column-sum classification and parameter transitions require the supplied proof. Specialized or incompletely indexed prior literature might contain equivalent formulas.
title: Clique–star products: exact endpoint Hodge norms and switching edge directions
